mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% over 3 months signals aggressive monetary easing, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 4.0% within 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal dovish monetary policy combined with weak price pressures, which typically boosts equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as investors anticipate central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus, generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity, as measured by monthly housing starts, typically signals robust consumer demand and economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1300.0 units signals weakening consumer demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth concerns mount.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in both housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above 1400.0 and 700000.0 respectively, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals strong manufacturing activity and economic output, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
